title: Trader Assistant Pro: reading companion
summary: A concise chapter guide with original illustrations and links to the author's full manual.

sections.title: Using this companion
sections.body: Choose a chapter from the contents, then follow its source link for the full text and screenshots. The illustrations below are original educational schematics. This companion does not reproduce the book or establish a trading edge.

sections.title: Version notes
sections.body: Version 2 adds presets, trade gating, revised alerts, and adaptive filters.

sections.title: 01 · Orientation
sections.body: Introduces the indicator's purpose, limitations, markets, and suggested reading routes.

sections.title: 02 · Configuration
sections.body: Covers installation, sizing, trend context, dashboard setup, and instrument presets.

sections.title: 03 · Chart elements
sections.body: Separates trend context, pattern geometry, planned levels, and entry confirmation.

sections.title: 04 · Pattern structure
sections.body: Explains impulse–pullback geometry, retracement zones, formation stages, scoring, and invalidation.

sections.title: Illustration · Price structure
sections.alt: Original hypothetical bullish and bearish impulse and pullback paths.
sections.caption: Original schematic; dashed paths represent possibilities, not forecasts.

sections.title: 05 · Trade lifecycle
sections.body: Follows setup assessment, pullback, reversal confirmation, execution, exits, and journaling.

sections.title: Illustration · Decision sequence
sections.alt: Original observation, planning, confirmation, execution, and review sequence.
sections.caption: General workflow. Planning and recorded execution are distinct.

sections.title: 06 · Configuration choices
sections.body: Compares three approaches; presets override selected inputs. Optimization is in-sample.

sections.title: 07 · Risk controls
sections.body: Distinguishes risk sizing, margin, leverage, portfolio exposure, and loss-streak rules.

sections.title: Illustration · Position sizing
sections.alt: Original conceptual position sizing formula with cash risk and per-unit stop distance.
sections.caption: Conceptual sizing before costs. Instrument specifications and execution matter.

sections.title: 08 · Notifications
sections.body: Separates preparatory armed alerts from confirmed-trade events and webhook messages.

sections.title: 09 · Statistics
sections.body: Dashboard trades are virtual; preset results omit costs and count breakeven as wins.

sections.title: 10 · Process errors
sections.body: Reviews confirmation, trend, overexposure, stop changes, emotional trading, and recordkeeping.

sections.title: 11 · Optional tools
sections.body: Adds gap, structure, volume, and volatility tools; anchors lock at Entry touch.

sections.title: 12 · Troubleshooting
sections.body: Clarifies signal, preset, access, and replay questions; concludes with checklists.

notes: Reviewed October 13, 2026. The author's live manual may change; its text and screenshots are not archived here.
The chapter descriptions summarize the author's material. Abacus has not verified the indicator, its code, or its claimed performance.
Original source: Willy Collins. Reproduction permission was not established; the user selected this brief companion instead of a full copy.
